chapter.heading: A song for pilgrims ascending to Jerusalem.
chapter.v:
How joyful
are those who fear the Lord—all who follow his ways!

You will
enjoy the fruit of your labor.How joyful and prosperous you will be!

Your wife
will be like a fruitful grapevine,flourishing within your home.Your children will be like vigorous young olive treesas they sit around your table.

That is
the Lord’s blessingfor those who fear him.

May the
Lord continually bless you from Zion.May you see Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.

May you
live to enjoy your grandchildren.May Israel have peace!
